definition: Nutanix Calm is an application automation tool for modeling, deploying and managing applications across infrastructure environments.
entry_text: Nutanix Calm is an application automation tool for modeling, deploying and managing applications across infrastructure environments.
example: A team defines a blueprint for deploying application and database services together.
label: Nutanix Calm

sources.note: Nutanix names Calm as the previous name of NCM Self-Service and describes blueprint-based provisioning and application lifecycle orchestration across hybrid clouds.
